question: Does charging two Compute per committed Dossier card reduce frequent AGI winner overrides and strategic dominance while preserving multiple viable two-of-three evidence routes?
requiredDiagnostics: profile and faction win shares by supported player count
Dossier commitments, payment failures, supported evidence, declaration, and winner override rates
Core Action and Program selection frequencies

selectionRule.candidatePreferred: Select the candidate only if AGI remains reachable near the registered five-percent target and four-player homogeneous strategy dominance falls without exceeding faction, seat, interaction, pairwise, diversity, or three/five-player bounds.
selectionRule.canonicalPreferred: Retain one Compute per Commit if the higher reserve deletes the AGI path, makes Fund compulsory, strengthens Compute-rich factions beyond bounds, or fails to improve strategy dominance.
selectionRule.interpretation: The one-lever result may select a candidate for human review. It does not establish human balance or promote the rule automatically.
selectionRule.physicalBoundary: Any selected cost requires synchronized Dossier copy, player aids, browser behavior, tests, a fresh release candidate, and explicit user approval.
